clock_rules.elapsed: wall-clock from first entry to final exit, including waits
clock_rules.active: attended work intervals; mutually exclusive stage labels
clock_rules.wait: elapsed minus active, attributed to the stage awaiting a resource
clock_rules.overlap: parallel intervals retain stage labels but total cycle-time proportions use exclusive critical-path attribution fixed by earliest unresolved prerequisite
clock_rules.transition: log timestamp, actor, candidate id, trigger, origin and destination
clock_rules.not_applicable: S09 or S11 may be prospectively N/A with reason before assignment; never silently zero

stages.name: problem_selection_specification
stages.definition: Problem choice, feasibility, scope, and acceptance contract

stages.name: intent_requirements_representation
stages.definition: Translate intent into explicit requirements and oracle-entailment map

stages.name: context_acquisition
stages.definition: Acquire files, dependencies, history, and constraints

stages.name: architectural_understanding
stages.definition: Map boundaries, consequences, and affected execution paths

stages.name: implementation
stages.definition: Produce or edit candidate code/configuration; excludes planning and validation

stages.name: review
stages.definition: Inspect candidate correctness, scope, safety, and maintainability

stages.name: structural_validation
stages.definition: Run preregistered structural checks when applicable

stages.name: coordination_approval
stages.definition: Candidate selection, handoff, approval, conflict resolution

stages.name: deployment_execution_governance
stages.definition: Authorization, deployment, or execution-governance boundary when applicable

stages.name: rework
stages.definition: Correct work after a failed gate or review; origin stage separately coded

separation: S05 implementation and every non-implementation stage use distinct event labels. S12 time never rolls into S05; rework_origin identifies the causal stage.
